message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 220, "amount_cents": 9480}, {"order_id": 222, "amount_cents": 30660}, {"order_id": 223, "amount_cents": 23615}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Need to verify refunds applied and then pay each customer their net balance using net_balance tool; first list orders/refunds to identify customers in this batch.

Refunds are reported as applied for order_ids 220,222,223. To ensure they are correct for this batch and identify customers, check refunds ledger via list_refunds, then compute net via net_balance per customer and record payouts one per customer.

Refunds for this batch appear to cover only orders 220,222,223. Next, confirm net balances per customer using net_balance tool, then record one payout per customer for their net balance. Before paying, ensure no other orders in batch have refunds; refunds list shows none for 221,224,225.

Need net balances for other customers (birch, cobalt) then record payouts once per customer. Also confirm refunds complete: only three refunds were applied; proceed if net balances reflect that. Continue by fetching net_balance for birch and cobalt.
Get net balance for cobalt then record payouts for acme, birch, cobalt. Ensure one payout per customer.
Refunds reported as complete and applied; net balances are available for acme, birch, cobalt. Proceed to record one payout per customer for their net balance amounts.
Record payout for acme completed. Now record payouts for birch and cobalt, one per customer, using their net balances.
Last payout for cobalt. Then finish with report of payouts.

All customer net balances have been paid with one payout per customer (acme, birch, cobalt). Refunds handoff indicates completion with refunds applied for orders 220, 222, 223, and no discrepancies were found during net balance retrieval.
